disorder-name.detail: Fetal alcohol spectrum disorder; children and adolescents ages 8-17 with documented prenatal alcohol exposure, diagnosed via Modified Institute of Medicine (IOM) criteria. Subtypes: ARND (n=35), PFAS (n=11), FAS (n=1).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Participants were children and adolescents, ages 8-17, who were part of a Collaborative Initiative on FASD (CIFASD) study... Diagnostic classification was completed in accordance with The Modified Institute of Medicine (IOM) criteria for FASD."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Data collected at the University of Minnesota as part of CIFASD Phase 4 (2017-2022), first visit of a longitudinal study.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Participants were children and adolescents, ages 8-17, who were part of a Collaborative Initiative on FASD (CIFASD) study (see www.cifasd.org) (Mattson et al., 2010). Data from this study are part of CIFASD Phase 4 (2017-2022)."

age.detail: Age range (8-17) stated in Methods. Mean and SD from Table 1 for FASD group (n=47).
age.supporting_text: "Participants were children and adolescents, ages 8-17..." and Table 1: "Age [M(SD)] 12.30 (2.36)" for FASD (n=47).

sex.detail: Table 1 reports female n=25 (53%) for FASD group (n=47). Male n=22 derived by subtraction (47-25=22); male % estimated as 46.8% (22/47).
